findings.message: T001 description includes upstream workflow/design prose beyond target + operation + anchor: “mirroring the established command surface while delegating canonical workflow behavior to its `.harness` source of truth.” Remove the restatement; cite the relevant anchors only. See `knowledge/conventions/no-upstream-restatement.md`.

T002 description restates behavioral contract in “post-merge return to the configured base branch” and “keeping merge an explicit user operation,” plus workflow delegation prose. Reduce it to target + operation + anchor cite. See `knowledge/conventions/no-upstream-restatement.md`.

T003 description includes upstream boundary/workflow prose: “with only canonical invocation, tool constraints, and reporting boundary; retain workflow behavior in its `.harness` source of truth.” Reduce it to target + operation + anchor cite. See `knowledge/conventions/no-upstream-restatement.md`.

Section S1 description restates implementation behavior and authority: “separate thin adapters for the explicit merge and post-merge completion operations; preserve `.harness` as the workflow authority.” Section descriptions should summarize executable grouping without restating upstream behavior. See `knowledge/conventions/no-upstream-restatement.md`.

Section S2 description restates upstream design rationale/behavior: “thin Codex adapter for canonical pre-track ADR authoring without duplicating provider-independent workflow logic.” Remove the restatement from the section description. See `knowledge/conventions/no-upstream-restatement.md`.

T003 does not actually cover IN-03/CN-02/AC-02: those elements require creating a provider-independent ADR-add workflow SSoT under `.harness/workflows/`, but T003 targets only `.agents/skills/adr-add/SKILL.md`. All tasks could therefore finish with the required SSoT still absent. Add the workflow target and creation operation to T003, or introduce an earlier task and update the coverage mappings.

AC-02 requires all three skills to retain workflow authority in `.harness`, but the declared in-scope work only adds files under `.agents/skills/`. In particular, `adr-add` currently has no provider-independent workflow SSoT under `.harness/workflows/`, so satisfying this acceptance criterion necessarily requires work outside the declared scope.

The related-convention list includes conventions that do not apply to this documentation-only adapter track: `responsibility-boundary.md` governs CI/verifier enforcement, while `language-policy.md#Rust First`, `coding-principles.md`, and `prefer-type-safe-abstractions.md` govern implementation code. These off-topic inputs can misdirect downstream planning despite the track intentionally having no code/type work.
